# iiko
> Cloud-based restaurant management platform for POS, delivery, kitchen operations, loyalty, and analytics.

iiko provides software for restaurants, cafés, bars, and chains, covering front-of-house, back-office, delivery, customer engagement, and integrations. The site includes product information, industry solutions, support resources, and partner-oriented materials.

## Product Overview
- [Restaurant Management](https://iiko.it/): Overview of iiko’s platform for restaurant operations, sales, and control.
- [Point of Sale](https://iiko.it/): POS capabilities for order taking, payments, and service workflows.
- [Delivery Management](https://iiko.it/): Tools for delivery orchestration, dispatching, and order processing.
- [Kitchen Display and Operations](https://iiko.it/): Kitchen workflow support for preparation, timing, and coordination.
- [Loyalty and CRM](https://iiko.it/): Customer retention, promotions, and guest engagement capabilities.
- [Analytics and Reporting](https://iiko.it/): Business intelligence and reporting for restaurant performance monitoring.

## Solutions by Business Type
- [Restaurants](https://iiko.it/): Solutions tailored for full-service restaurant operations and management.
- [Cafés and Coffee Shops](https://iiko.it/): Tools for fast service, repeat guests, and compact operations.
- [Bars and Pubs](https://iiko.it/): Support for beverage-led venues, tabs, and rapid service.
- [Pizzerias](https://iiko.it/): Features for dine-in, takeaway, and delivery-heavy pizza businesses.
- [Dark Kitchens](https://iiko.it/): Centralized workflows for delivery-only and virtual kitchen models.
- [Restaurant Chains](https://iiko.it/): Multi-location management, standardization, and centralized reporting.

## Core Functional Areas
- [Front Office](https://iiko.it/): Service, cashier, and guest-facing workflows for daily operations.
- [Back Office](https://iiko.it/): Inventory, purchasing, finance, and administrative restaurant controls.
- [Inventory Management](https://iiko.it/): Stock tracking, write-offs, recipes, and ingredient cost control.
- [Staff Management](https://iiko.it/): Scheduling, permissions, and labor-related operational oversight.
- [Table Service](https://iiko.it/): Seating, table management, and waiter service processes.
- [Takeaway and Pickup](https://iiko.it/): Order handling for collection and off-premise fulfillment.

## Delivery and Guest Experience
- [Online Ordering](https://iiko.it/): Digital ordering flows for direct restaurant sales channels.
- [Courier Management](https://iiko.it/): Dispatch and courier coordination for delivery operations.
- [Call Center Support](https://iiko.it/): Centralized order intake and customer communication workflows.
- [Mobile Waiter Tools](https://iiko.it/): Mobile service support for staff taking and managing orders.
- [Guest Loyalty](https://iiko.it/): Rewards, segmentation, and repeat-visit marketing features.
- [Promotions](https://iiko.it/): Discounting and campaign tools for customer acquisition and retention.

## Integrations and Ecosystem
- [Integrations](https://iiko.it/): Overview of connected services and third-party ecosystem support.
- [Payment Integrations](https://iiko.it/): Payment processing compatibility for restaurant transactions.
- [Delivery Integrations](https://iiko.it/): Connections for delivery channels and fulfillment workflows.
- [Hardware Compatibility](https://iiko.it/): Supported devices and operational hardware environment.
- [Partner Opportunities](https://iiko.it/): Information for resellers, implementers, and business partners.
- [Enterprise Connectivity](https://iiko.it/): Centralized integration support for larger restaurant groups.
